description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: NEO Emacs (WIP): GPU powered Emacs written in Rust with a modern display engine. Aiming for modern design & multi-threaded Elisp, 10x performance, zero-pause concurrent GC and 100% Emacs compatibility.
岛仔 Daozai：Rust 构建的 Windows 桌面信息岛。音乐歌词、邮件验证码、日程提醒、待办与 AI 额度，让重要信息轻轻出现在屏幕顶部。
Lightweight (~1.5 MB) open-source screen annotation with click-through mode and keyboard-first shortcuts. For demos, teaching, meetings & screen recording. Windows, macOS.
Atom, Open-Source Governed AI Agent Platform for Self-Hosted Trained Agents For Your Business
Fast, free voice assistant for your Mac. No API key. Remembers you and learns your shortcuts. Hold ⌃⌥Space and talk.
Ever® Teams™ - The Workplace for Humans. Open Work & Productivity Platform - https://ever.team
Your tasks, your server. An open-source, local-first task manager you can host yourself. Everything you expect from a commercial task app, without the subscription or the lock-in.
The ultimate open-source Android gesture & one-hand navigation suite. An all-in-one OHO+ (One Hand Operation+), FooView & Quick Cursor alternative with offline OCR and Shizuku.
Troupe any Agents in one UI for Claude, ChatGPT, Antigravity and 30+ more
A free, open-source macOS drag-and-drop shelf and Dynamic Island for files, images, text and links. Built with SwiftUI + AppKit.

Free, on-device AI dictation and meeting notes for macOS. Sub-second dictation with Parakeet and Whisper on Apple Silicon, plus optional AI polish. EnviousMeet (Beta): record calls with no bot, get who-said-what transcripts and AI summaries on your Mac. No account, no subscription, open source. Your audio never leaves your Mac.

Karui (軽い) is a offline only aesthetically pleasing, sync supported google tasks alternative to do list app, inspired by system-24 theme and windows mobile design system. It's a 145kb apk that allows you to take notes from status bar and from other apps with support for homescreen widgets! Made with ❤️ and Vue

Claude Code on your laptop and remote dev boxes, in one web page. Sessions keep running when SSH drops (no tmux), each session's changes get their own diff, plus tasks, notes, and memory. Self-hosted.

Aetox harness: a local-first Windows AI environment - model, skills, team and memory as one system. Two doors - an Assistant that adapts to your work and drives a real browser; and a Developer that names each weakness before writing, checks the project's security, runs the project's tests before saying done, and remembers what this project decided.
Open-source clipboard manager for macOS, Windows & Android: clipboard history, encrypted LAN sync, file transfer. macOS screenshots/OCR, snippets, AI token usage, Keep Awake. 开源跨平台剪贴板管理、局域网同步、截图与防休眠。
